chunks: As for what al-Hasan ibn Sama'ah narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, he said:
I asked him about the time of Maghrib. He said: He said to me: Delay Maghrib a little, for the sun sets where you are before it sets where we are.

key_terms.الشَّمْسَ: the sun, whose setting marks the prayer time
key_terms.تَغِيبُ: sets or disappears below the horizon
key_terms.مَسُّوا: delay slightly or wait a little
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the appointed time or timing of an act

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Maghrib salat (prayer) begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the time of Maghrib salat (prayer), instructing that it be delayed slightly. It indicates consideration of local sunset conditions in determining the proper prayer time.
